Answer the multiple-choice question below.

Question:
Simulate the geochemical equilibration of 1 kg of a 100°C aqueous solution at pH 5 containing 100 mmol/kgw of dissolved Barium at equilibrium with a mineral assemblage consisting of 10 moles each of Talc, Rhodochrosite, Sepiolite (including the disordered form), and Lead Hydroxide [Pb(OH)2​].

What is the saturation index of Sepiolite(d)?

A. -8.81
B. -8.83
C. -8.82
D. -8.86

Use tools as needed for PHREEQC / quantitative work.

tool_calls.name: write_file
tool_calls.arguments:
{"path":"input.inp","new_content":"SOLUTION 1
    temp 100
    pH 5 charge
    units mmol/kgw
    Ba 100

EQUILIBRIUM_PHASES 1
    Talc 0 10
    Rhodochrosite 0 10
    Sepiolite 0 10
    Sepiolite(d) 0 10
    Pb(OH)2 0 10

END"}

SOLUTION 1
    temp 100
    pH 5 charge
    units mmol/kgw
    Ba 100

EQUILIBRIUM_PHASES 1
    Talc 0 10
    Rhodochrosite 0 10
    Sepiolite 0 10
    Sepiolite(d) 0 10
    Pb(OH)2 0 10

END
